name: Frigate
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original transparent spaceship sprite for Orion Reach, a space strategy game. Polished realistic painted 3D-render appearance, matching the game's existing pale warm-gray ceramic armor, charcoal navy structural metal, muted bronze mechanical fittings, restrained cyan windows and engines. Fine functional mechanical detailing and subtle wear, crisp readable silhouette that remains distinct at 40–160 pixels. Not a cartoon or vector icon.
Camera/composition: STRICT directly overhead orthographic top-down view, looking straight down at the dorsal surface, symmetric left/right, long axis exactly vertical, pointed BOW at TOP and stern engines at BOTTOM. No oblique angle or perspective. ONE complete ship centered on square canvas, all extremities fully visible, at least 8 percent empty margin on each side. Soft neutral light from upper left.
Background: genuine transparent alpha. No space background, stars, planet, terrain, platform, shadows cast on an imaginary surface, opaque backdrop, checkerboard, labels, text, insignia or watermark. No detached escort craft. Short contained engine glow only; no long exhaust trails, weapon fire or explosions. The class must read from silhouette without text.
Subject: A small agile escort warship with a slender arrowhead prow, narrow armored central spine, two short swept-back side fins carrying compact gun housings, one small raised bridge and paired compact cyan engines. Sparse armor, clean fast silhouette. Narrowest crewed combat ship in this architectural family.
